status_policy: Implementation tasks require acceptance evidence and merge before complete; ready_for_review records verified branch work; in_progress and blocked preserve outstanding scope. Planning IDs are not issue numbers.

tasks.title: Reproduce baseline builds
tasks.acceptance: Record compiler/CMake/SDL/platform versions, configure/build commands, test discovery and actual headless/client/graphics outcomes.
tasks.notes: Linux baseline/export results preserved; runtime import passes headless 77/77 and full SDL 89/89, with selected tools-disabled tests 2/2 and a dummy-video live process smoke. Windows/UCRT64 and visible playtesting remain unverified.

tasks.title: Publish documentation and focused cleanup
tasks.acceptance: Add the indexed pack on a dedicated branch/PR, reconcile older docs, list exact removals, validate links and preserve useful existing material.
evidence: Documentation checker: all local links/anchors, JSON examples, backlog parity and dependencies passed; remote file blobs verified against local content.
tasks.notes: Documentation pack and focused cleanup delivered in PR #3. This does not complete runtime milestones. Planning ID; not a GitHub issue number.

tasks.title: Resolve source and documentation drift
tasks.acceptance: Correct the ledger; decide the final quest target wording; separate old PR findings from current verified issues; record remaining decisions.
tasks.notes: Planning ID; not a GitHub issue number.

tasks.title: Inventory all placement ownership
tasks.acceptance: Trace ground, object, station, NPC, monster, label, quest and initialization ownership with source links.
tasks.notes: All source placement owners, ordered terrain, objects, labels, quests and actor initialization traced. Inventory delivered for review; baseline platform work remains open.

tasks.title: Audit position and save compatibility
tasks.acceptance: Cover player creation/loading/death/respawn, recovery piles, spawn catalogue checks, interaction approach tiles and historical saves.
tasks.notes: Inventory covers direct/loaded player positions, respawn, recovery piles, spawn equality, approaches and wire versions 1–13. No edited-world migration acceptance claimed.

tasks.title: Decide minimal content architecture
tasks.acceptance: Record parser, schema representation, target dependencies, coordinates and preview design ADRs with consequences.
tasks.notes: Bounded ASCII parser, snapshot representation, shared core ownership and selected runtime input decided in ADR-017. Preview/backend remains open.

tasks.title: Capture semantic baseline fixtures
tasks.acceptance: Snapshot terrain/occupancy and lifecycle stages; define deterministic behavioural checks without overfitting transient IDs.
tasks.notes: Existing export grid/actor/path fixtures are supplemented by compiled-versus-imported runtime construction and lifecycle tests. Importer execution is recorded separately from the original exporter baseline.

tasks.title: Define a genuine fresh-player profile
tasks.acceptance: Specify non-boosted skills/items/tutorial state and disposable saves; distinguish it from current development defaults.
tasks.notes: Planning ID; not a GitHub issue number.

tasks.title: Reproduce multi-step shop arbitrage
tasks.acceptance: Replay the source-derived Log→planks→shield chain; record actual net coins, constraints and stock behaviour; correct/test confirmed loops before balance signoff.
tasks.notes: Planning ID; not a GitHub issue number.

tasks.title: Define authored region model
tasks.acceptance: Represent region identity, dimensions, ground, placements, definition references and ground surface without changing current gameplay.
tasks.notes: The exact current 100x100 starter model supports terrain, placement coordinates and player spawn as input while retaining definitions/lifecycle. General region/identity authoring remains unsupported.

tasks.title: Implement bounded codec and canonical writer
tasks.acceptance: Round-trip valid fixtures deterministically; reject malformed/oversized/unsupported/duplicate content before allocation or map writes.
tasks.notes: Strict schema-1 ASCII parser and canonical writer implement input/depth/value/string/container budgets, complete binding checks and round-trip/rejection coverage. Broader schema evolution remains open.

tasks.title: Export current world read-only
tasks.acceptance: Export actual 100×100 definitions, pond, overlays, placements and lifecycle metadata; compare complete semantic baseline.
tasks.notes: Compiled baseline export remains deterministic and read-only. Existing local exporter evidence is retained; later input/runtime behaviour has separate verification.

tasks.title: Integrate content validation providers
tasks.acceptance: Use existing rule semantics; establish one canonical definition provider and preserve spawn authority checks.
tasks.notes: Selected spawn catalogue is owned by each World and retains type, capacity and lifecycle checks. Other gameplay definition catalogues remain compiled.

tasks.title: Maintain stable ID and migration registry
tasks.acceptance: Map authored IDs to current enums, forbid silent reuse/renumbering, document aliases/removals and test references.
tasks.notes: Parser binds the complete 20-placement registry to existing enum/type/config/lifecycle identities. Coordinates may change; ID allocation, aliases/removals and general migrations remain future work.

tasks.title: Validate static placement safety
tasks.acceptance: Reject out-of-bounds/overlap/bad-reference/blocked-spawn cases using authoritative occupancy rules and precise diagnostics.
tasks.notes: Runtime validator rejects invalid dimensions, references, bounds, overlaps, water placements and occupied player spawn before world construction. Scope is the current 100x100 starter registry.

tasks.title: Validate mandatory route and approach access
tasks.acceptance: Use actual diagonal and interaction semantics to prove required services, spawn and exits reachable; test false-positive traps.
tasks.notes: Runtime validation checks actor reachability and a reachable cardinal approach for every placement under current blocking/no-corner-cut semantics. General regions/exits and broader geography diagnostics remain unsupported.

tasks.title: Define map-update position compatibility
tasks.acceptance: Specify and test safe player/respawn/recovery-data handling when geometry changes, preserving unrelated progress.
tasks.notes: Selected player spawn governs creation, death respawn and unsafe saved-position fallback; recovery accessibility is handled within the single imported starter region. Save version remains 13; broader migration manifests/region identity remain open.

tasks.title: Load content through compatibility adapter
tasks.acceptance: Match baseline terrain/occupancy/lifecycle and save behaviour; make rollback explicit and invalid file failure observable.
tasks.notes: World constructs a validated snapshot with retained terrain/occupancy and staged IDs. CLI explicitly selects input or compiled content; bad input fails and imported playtests default to no save. General publication/rollback packages remain planned.

tasks.title: Implement shared edit operations
tasks.acceptance: Typed inspect/paint/place/move/remove/validate/diff/save operations produce a candidate and affected references; first release exposes bounded scope.
tasks.notes: The stacked edit operations now include pure runtime-validated stable-ID resource/station moves and one-tile G/D/S/W ground painting; the terminal history supports undo and redo across both kinds, and the Tk bridge can issue mouse paint. The C++ validation authority is shared. Broader placement creation/removal, structured diagnostics, full project compilation and real editor/game verification remain open.

tasks.title: Guard writes and dry runs
tasks.acceptance: Expected content hash, file locking/recheck and atomic replacement prevent stale writes; dry-run persists nothing.
tasks.notes: Experimental create-only sibling draft publication with raw-byte SHA-256 expected hash, source recheck under cooperating-directory lock, private staging and exclusive hard-link commit. Original source and save files never overwritten. No in-place atomic replacement, crash-durability guarantee or general editor yet. Full repository build/tests and Windows are unverified; isolated C++ storage tests and mock CLI/CMake checks only.

tasks.title: Provide headless CLI
tasks.acceptance: Document supported syntax, structured diagnostics and exit outcomes; tests operate without SDL.
tasks.notes: Headless export, snapshot validation, dry-run moves and terrain paint, guarded draft publication and an interactive terminal map/list/move/paint/undo/redo/save session are staged. Structured machine diagnostics, full project compilation and real command execution have not been verified on the stacked editor branch.

tasks.title: Add undo and redo
tasks.acceptance: Reverse complete commands/batches while retaining authored identity; reject incompatible history after external changes.
tasks.notes: C++ history stages bounded stable-ID move batches and one-tile terrain paint with a shared cursor, semantic conflict check and reversible undo/redo. Both text and Tk editing sessions use the shared engine history. Unit/regression sources are committed, but a complete C++ build, real runtime tests and persisted history acceptance remain open.

tasks.title: Produce reproducible previews
tasks.acceptance: Preview true content, occupancy and selected overlays; share interpretation and version rendering inputs.
tasks.notes: A bounded terminal 21x21 terrain-and-occupancy preview now accompanies in-memory shared-history move/undo/redo and guarded new-draft saving. This is not a graphical editor, complete renderer, preview-artifact format or verified publication. New code passed isolated GCC C++20 syntax and mock-backed session smoke checks; full project tests remain unrun.

tasks.title: Recover separately stored drafts
tasks.acceptance: Recover last valid draft after interruption; distinguish draft/base/published states and handle conflicts without overwriting publication.
tasks.notes: Planning ID; not a GitHub issue number.

tasks.title: Implement validated publication selection
tasks.acceptance: Bind validation to exact content/validator versions; publish immutable manifest and load its selected version in a fresh session.
tasks.notes: Planning ID; not a GitHub issue number.

tasks.title: Make batch transactions conflict-safe
tasks.acceptance: Validate final candidate atomically; reject partial application, unexpected file changes and unsafe paths.
tasks.notes: Planning ID; not a GitHub issue number.

tasks.title: Build minimal visual editor shell
tasks.acceptance: Open/select/inspect/move/paint with shared commands; preserve camera and coordinate transforms.
tasks.notes: First mouse-driven Python/Tk editor now stages zoom, selection, stable-ID resource/station moves, G/D/S/W painting, shared C++ undo/redo and guarded create-only draft saving. C++ returns authoritative terrain rows; the bridge checks initial stable-ID placement kind/coordinate parity with the source and rejects invalid post-edit kinds, bounds or actor-spawn movement before changing the view. Mock bridge regressions were added; 9 isolated parity checks and 5 fake-line execution checks passed, but the full checked-in Python suite and C++/Tk/game integration remain unexecuted because this host cannot check out the repository. The new optional executable-backed Python/C++ bridge integration gate is committed but unexecuted in the container; running it against the real built tool, GUI interaction and a saved-world game playtest remain outstanding. On PR #18, the bridge additionally requires exact move/paint response deltas and history cursor transitions, rejecting tool/UI divergence before state mutation; four mock regression cases were added and the extracted Python checker passed 4 isolated unittest cases. Full repo / real executable integration is still unverified.
